data.name: Dazzling Feint
data.description: Each time a vexing daredevil successfully feints against a creature under the effect of her hypnotic stare, she also chooses one of her dazzling feint benefits to activate. Unless otherwise stated, a dazzling feint's benefit applies only on the vexing daredevil's next attack this round. The DC for any saving throw against a dazzling feint's effect is %1.|DazzlingFeintDC
